basic_info.description: Tucked into the serene and coveted Forest Knolls neighborhood, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath townhouse with a spacious 2-car garage is brimming with opportunity. For the buyer with vision, this is a rare chance to reimagine an original-condition home into something uniquely yours.    The floor plan offers all the right ingredients: three generous bedrooms, a light-filled living area, and a dining room that opens directly to a private outdoor patio, perfect for entertaining or quiet evenings outdoors. With a full three bathrooms and an attached 2 car garage, functionality is already built in. Now it's ready for your creativity.    Whether you dream of sleek modern finishes, timeless mid-century details, or a warm and inviting traditional style, this home is a true blank canvas. Here, your investment isn't just in square footage, it's in the opportunity to bring your own taste and design to life in one of San Francisco's few gated communities.    Don't miss the chance to transform this Forest Knolls gem into a home that reflects your vision and adds long-term value for years to come.
